about_the_game:
Cybernoir: Demo

Cybernoir is a cyberpunk open-world action game combining intense combat, nonlinear storytelling, and immersive detective gameplay. The full game is currently in development – and this demo gives you an exclusive first look at the world, mechanics, and atmosphere of Cybernoir.

What's Included in This Demo?

  • Several optional side activities
    Chase down criminals, investigate crime scenes, and take on short tasks that showcase different gameplay elements.

  • Early combat mechanics
    Experience a first version of both melee and ranged combat systems.

  • Basic traffic and pedestrian system
    Get a glimpse of the living, breathing city environment with early AI-driven traffic and pedestrians.

  • Sample character and vehicle upgrades
    Try out limited upgrade options for your character and vehicle.

  • Estimated playtime:
    Around 20–40 minutes, depending on your playstyle and exploration.

What Will Be in the Full Game?

  • A fully open city
    Multiple districts filled with places to explore, stories to uncover, and dangers to face.

  • Dozens of main and side missions
    Engage in a variety of story-driven and action-packed missions.

  • A deep investigation system
    Solve complex criminal cases with detective tools and decision-based outcomes.

  • Advanced AI systems
    Dynamic behavior for civilians, gang members, and police forces.

  • Expanded combat and stealth mechanics
    More tactical options and polished combat for different playstyles.

  • Full voice acting and enhanced visuals
    Experience the full narrative and visual immersion with professional voice work and upgraded graphics.

  

                           

This demo represents an early work-in-progress slice of the full Cybernoir experience.

Your feedback is valuable as we continue development.
